name: BlogLite Web Application
work: Built BlogLite, a lightweight and user-friendly blogging platform that allows users to post images with a title and description.
Utilized Flask and Vue to develop the application, showcasing proficiency in JavaScript and RESTful API development.
Implemented image storage capabilities to enable users to upload and display images within their blog posts.

name: Kanban Web Application
work: Created a task management application called Kanban, allowing users to create and manage multiple task lists.
Developed a web application using Vue.js 2 and Flask, leveraging their respective strengths for frontend and backend implementation.
Implemented APIs using Flask Blueprints to ensure a modular and scalable architecture.

name: Traffic Control Management
work: Conducted a comprehensive study of various implementations of Traffic Management Systems.
Collaborated with faculty at VIT Vellore on a project focused on Disaster Recovery and Business Continuity Protocols, leveraging VANET Systems and Image Processing Techniques.
Utilized Image Processing Techniques to analyze and process traffic-related data for efficient decision-making.
